description: Return the full proof behind a value: the proof itself (filing accession, form and filing date, XBRL taxonomy, tag and dimensions, source URL, page and anchor), the kind (std for a standardized value, ar for a raw as-reported fact), the value object, the concept it maps to, the company, the filing summary, the raw as-reported facts the standardized value derives from, and the derivation (method, calc_type and the pipeline run). For a ratio (kind "ratio") it also returns the formula and the standardized input values, each with its own proof. Every value object carries proof.id; pass it here when a person asks "where does this number come from" or before quoting a figure in a report. A human page exists at meta.proof_base + proof_id.

proof_id.description: The proof id from a value object, for example p_01JC....

name: proof_get

outputSchema.description: The FinancialMD envelope (docs/API.md section 2): data plus meta (request_id, as_of knowledge time, matched company, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base). Every numeric value inside data is an object with value, unit, currency, period, known interval, restated flag, method and a proof pointing at the filing. On failure the result is isError with an error object instead.

data.description: { proof, kind (std or ar), value, concept { concept_id, label, statement } or null, company, filing, derived_from (raw facts), derivation { method, calc_type, run } or null }.

proof.description: Where a value comes from: filing accession, form, filing date, taxonomy and tag, source URL, page and anchor.

inputs.description: For derived values (ratios): the proof ids of the inputs.

value.description: A proven number: value, unit, currency, decimals, period, known interval, restated, method, calc_type, proof.

proof.description: Where a value comes from: filing accession, form, filing date, taxonomy and tag, source URL, page and anchor.

inputs.description: For derived values (ratios): the proof ids of the inputs.

error.description: Present only on isError results: the API error code and message plus remedy hints.

meta.description: Request metadata: request_id, as_of, company resolution, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base.

attribution.description: Citations a source requires on anything shown from the answer.

title: Proof for a value
